name: Build A Tank
desc:
🚗 Design your own tank and destroy all the obstacles in your way! Watch out for the turrets!

🛠️ The shop refreshes with new stuff!
💵 Earn money by destroying obstacles!
⚔️ Make sure you have enough ammo and rockets!
💾 Save your tank!

🔥Your tank shoots offline so COME BACK FOR YOUR REWARD!
